children: Italy cloud marketing tech firm's half-year revenue rose 11.5% yr/yr to EUR 40.3 mln
EBITDA for half-year returned to positive EUR 1.2 mln, after prior yr loss
Company ended half-year with EUR 9.2 mln cash, improving liquidity position
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods
BUSINESS UNIT EXPANSION - Revenue growth driven by both SaaS and CPaaS business units, with Agile Telecom posting the largest increase
COST DISCIPLINE - Improved profitability attributed to strict cost discipline, with costs down almost 4% yr/yr and reduced R&D and general expenses
BEEFREE TURNOVER - BeeFree unit saw higher turnover driven by increasing volumes, though standalone EBITDA remained negative but improved
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Growens SpA is €3.60, about 98.9% above its September 14 closing price of €1.81
